g.text: Eight correlated slices from four parents · all 24 blocks per slice · three fixed methods
Lines pair the same development slice; colors mark parent groups. These outcomes were used in method development.
The dashed line is a numerical threshold, not a confidence interval. No IID-eight inference.
Ordinary floating point with an unverified cancellation allowance; no formal roundoff enclosure.
